# Getting started

Tsumiki runs on a server of your own.
"Workspace" means the place where a team keeps its documents.

## Install

1. Sign in to the server as an administrator and create a workspace.
2. Unpack the release archive.
3. Put the email address that receives notices in the settings file.

Supported version: 2.4
